description: This file contains functions and classes for interacting with the OpenWeatherMap API, including fetching current weather data by coordinates or city, generating weather summaries, providing weather-based activity recommendations, and utility functions for date-time parsing and validation.

classes.name: ServiceConfigError
classes.description: Custom exception raised when service configuration (like API keys) is missing.

methods.name: str get_openweather_api_key()
methods.description: Retrieves API key for OpenWeatherMap from environment variables, checking multiple common variable names.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] fetch_current_weather_by_coords(lat: float, lon: float)
methods.description: Fetches current weather data from OpenWeatherMap for given latitude and longitude.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] fetch_current_weather_by_city(city: str, state: Optional[str] = None, country: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Fetches current weather data from OpenWeatherMap based on city name, with optional state and country parameters.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Optional[float],Optional[float]] weather_summary(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Generates a simplified weather summary, including description, temperature, and precipitation.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] recommend_activity(payload: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Provides a weather-based activity recommendation based on the current weather payload.

methods.name: datetime parse_iso_datetime(value: str)
methods.description: Converts an ISO-8601 string into a timezone-aware UTC datetime object.

methods.name: datetime safe_now_utc()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC timestamp with timezone info.

methods.name: bool within_time_window(target: datetime, start: datetime, end: datetime)
methods.description: Checks if a target datetime falls within a specified start and end datetime range.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] msg(title: str, suggestion: str, color: str)

ctags.name: fetch_current_weather_by_city
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_current_weather_by_city(city: str, state: Optional[str] = None, country: Optional[str]/
ctags.signature: (city: str, state: Optional[str] = None, country: Optional[str] = None)

ctags.name: fetch_current_weather_by_coords
ctags.pattern: /^def fetch_current_weather_by_coords(lat: float, lon: float) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: msg
ctags.pattern: /^    def msg(title: str, suggestion: str, color: str) -> Dict[str, Any]:$/

ctags.name: weather_summary
ctags.pattern: /^def weather_summary(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> Tuple[str, Optional[float], Optional[float]]:$/

ctags.name: within_time_window
ctags.pattern: /^def within_time_window(target: datetime, start: datetime, end: datetime) -> bool:$/
